coordination.browser: One browser/effect owner uses the dedicated profile; one objective at a time; explicit send authorization, stable keys, and no blind resend.
coordination.ledger: One coordinated writer appends canonical live evidence and reconciles scenario status; preserve previous receipts.
coordination.conflicts: Exclusive write scopes; request owner handoff for cross-scope work. Shared files belong to C; do not overwrite concurrent edits.
coordination.integration: Daily integration commit only after scoped changes are reconciled and owners agree; preserve existing work.

process.statusRules: WORKS requires concrete scenario-specific live evidence; owner-provided live status here is provisional where the precise receipt was not supplied. PARTIAL means some observed portion works or a known prerequisite blocks completion. BROKEN means an observed defect prevents the expected outcome. UNKNOWN means not established; NOT_BUILT requires affirmative evidence the feature does not exist. Never infer provider success from a fixture, 200, APK build, or registry entry.
